input.summary: Remove the three-year take-or-pay minimum; Customer pays only for Services used or ordered.
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment: our playbook does not accept multi-year minimum purchase commitments with no reduction or termination right, and the clause also contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. If a commitment is commercially necessary, we can discuss one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and settled by a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term. Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or shortfall obligation.
